'''Spinefish''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of animal from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vodran/Legends|Vodran]]<ref name="GG12" /> in the [[Vodran system/Legends|Vodran system]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> of the [[Si'Klaata Cluster/Legends|Si'Klaata Cluster]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. They lived in the<ref name="GG12" /> stagnant<ref name="LoNH" /> [[river]]s of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] alongside the predatory [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]] and were caught by the native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species, the [[Vodran (species)/Legends|Vodran]]. The spinefish were caught by the Vodran during a primitive stage of the sentients history, at a [[Time/Legends|time]] when they lived above the [[Water/Legends|rivers]] in suspended thatched huts from which they hung down [[Net/Legends|nets]] to entangle the spinefish swimming below.<ref name="GG12" /> This practice was continued until as late as around [[25,100 BBY]].<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Spinefish were first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'' an installment in the ''[[Galaxy Guide]]'' series of supplements for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', a roleplaying game produced by [[West End Games]]. The species were mentioned in the entry for the Vodran species, which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="GG12" />
